verdict.rationale: Cline confirms JetBrains support (IntelliJ, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand) with the same experience as VS Code, and documents interactive diff review across VS Code and JetBrains ('every edit shows up as a diff you can review, modify, or revert'). However, there's no explicit evidence of a 'share selected code as context' feature specifically within the JetBrains plugin UI. missing for 10: JetBrains-specific documentation/screenshots of selecting code and adding it as context, independent hands-on confirmation of diff UI in JetBrains specifically.
